welcome.bubble: Hi there! I'm Benny. I help people grow their money God's way, one seed at a time.

promise.subtitle: A few quick questions, and I'll build a plan that's truly yours: your month, your goal, your debt. About 3 minutes.

name.question: First things first, what should I call you?
name.errEmpty: I'd love a name to call you by.

reasons.question: What brought you to DollarSeeds, {{name}}?
reasons.subtitle: Pick all that fit. I'll shape your plan around them.

options.debt: I want to get out of debt
options.honor: I want to honor God with my money
options.organized: I just want to get organized

reaction.debt: Freedom from debt is a beautiful goal. We'll start with your debts.
reaction.overspending: That's so common, and so fixable. Your month will show you exactly where it goes.
reaction.saving: I love that. Let's give it a date and a plan.
reaction.honor: That's the best reason there is. Everything we plant starts there.
reaction.organized: Peace of mind is coming. Every dollar will have a place.
reaction.many: Got it, all of those. I'll keep every one in mind.

feeling.question: Honestly, how does money feel for you right now?
feeling.subtitle: There's no wrong answer. It just helps me know how to help.

reaction.stressed: You're not alone in that. We'll take it one step at a time.
reaction.overwhelmed: Let's make it smaller together. One seed at a time is plenty.
reaction.hopeful: Hope is a great place to plant from. Let's grow it.
reaction.good: That's wonderful! Let's keep it growing.

feeling.short: How does money feel for you?

tithe.question: Do you give a tithe?
tithe.subtitle: If you do, I'll set it aside first, before anything else gets planted.

reaction.ten: Beautiful. Your tithe comes off the top, before anything else.
reaction.custom: That is an amazing act of faith!
reaction.none: That's okay. You can turn it on anytime in Settings.

income.question: How much money will you make this month (after taxes)?
income.subtitle: I'll give every dollar a place.

split.title: Here's your month, {{name}}.
split.bubble: Needs keep the lights on, Wants keep life fun, and Goals empower your future and big accomplishments.
split.note: That covers {{month}}. Starting next month, log each paycheck with the + next to your income.

expense.question: Let's log one thing you've bought this month.
expense.subtitle: Tap the + on Needs or Wants, wherever it belongs.
expense.reaction: That's it! Do this whenever you spend, and your plan stays true.

sheet.errWhat: Give it a short name so you'll recognize it later.

debtAsk.question: Do you have any debts you're working to pay off?
debtAsk.subtitle: Credit cards, loans, anything you owe. No judgment here, we're in this together.

reaction.yes: Thank you for trusting me with that. Let's plant it and watch it shrink.
reaction.free: Debt-free! That's a harvest worth celebrating.
reaction.later: Of course. The Debts tab will walk you through it whenever you're ready.

debtType.question: Let's plant your first one. What kind of debt is it?
debtType.errName: Give it a name you'll recognize.
debtType.short: What kind of debt is it?
debtType.subtitle: Pick the closest match. You can name it however you like.
debtType.reaction: Got it. Now give it a name you'll recognize.

debtDetails.bubble: Just a few numbers. You'll find them all on your statement.
debtDetails.owe: How much do you owe right now?
debtDetails.due: What day of the month is it due?
debtDetails.aprHelper: <bold>Optional.</bold> You'll find it on your statement. You can add it later.
debtDetails.errOwe: Just the amount you owe, like 2,400.
debtDetails.errApr: A rate like 22.9, or leave it blank for now.

debtPreview.bubble: Look at that, it's already growing. Every extra dollar gets you there sooner.
debtPreview.title: At your minimum, {{debt}} is paid off by <bold>{{date}}</bold>.
debtPreview.titleBeforeInterest: At your minimum, {{debt}} is paid off by <bold>{{date}}</bold>, before interest.
debtPreview.stalled: Right now your minimum barely covers the interest. Let's change that together.

goalPick.question: What's something you'd love to save up for?
goalPick.subtitle: Pick one to start. You can add more anytime.

reaction.emergency: Safety with your finances is key for peace of mind.
reaction.phone: It's always nice to have new tech!
reaction.vacation: Oh, a little getaway is always rejuvenating.
reaction.car: I can already smell that new car smell.
reaction.home: This is one of the most financially responsible goals.
reaction.wedding: Congratulations! What an amazing goal to save for.
reaction.gift: Doesn't gift giving just feel so great?!
reaction.other: Let's see what you've got up your sleeve.

goalPick.short: What would you love to save for?

goalDetails.bubble: Tell me a little more, and I'll work out the monthly amount.

goalPreview.title: You'll have your {{goal}} by <bold>{{date}}</bold>!
goalPreview.subtitle: Just {{amount}} a month. Tick it off on your Goals page each time.

commitment.bubble: One last thing, {{name}}. Let's pause for a moment.
commitment.subtitle: Whatever comes next, you won't walk it alone.
commitment.hold: Hold to say: “I want to steward what God has given me.”

plan.bubble: Amen! I'm so proud of you. This is a real plan.
plan.title: Here's your plan, {{name}}.
plan.debtStalled: {{debt}} is planted. Let's beat its interest together.

signup.title: Let's keep your plan safe.
signup.subtitle: Create your account so it's here every time you come back.
signup.errEmail: Hmm, that email doesn't look quite right.
signup.errPassword: Let's make it at least 6 characters.
signup.errTaken: Hmm, that email already has an account. Try signing in instead.
signup.errGeneric: Hmm, that didn't work. Let's try once more.
signup.confirmBody: I sent a link to {{email}}. Tap it, then come back here.
signup.confirmNotYet: Hmm, it looks like that link hasn't been tapped yet.

done.bubble: Come back tomorrow and log what you spend. I'll be here.
done.title: You're all set, {{name}}!

homeHint.text: Spent something? Tap a + to plant it in your plan.
